name: DCASE 2024 Task 7 Sound Scene Synthesis
description: This paper presents Task 7 at the DCASE 2024 Challenge: sound scene synthesis. Recent advances in sound synthesis and generative models have enabled the creation of realistic and diverse audio content. We introduce a standardized evaluation framework for comparing different sound scene synthesis systems, incorporating both objective and subjective metrics. The challenge attracted four submissions, which are evaluated using the Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD) and human perceptual ratings. Our analysis reveals significant insights into the current capabilities and limitations of sound scene synthesis systems, while also highlighting areas for future improvement in this rapidly evolving field.
reputation: A DCASE challenge task with community visibility in audio generation, but it is a recent and still emerging benchmark with few submissions.
notes: Small number of submissions and mixed objective/subjective evaluation. Human ratings and FAD may not align perfectly, and results can depend on generation settings and dataset conditioning.
